page.overview:
What is Withered Animatronics?

The Withered animatronics are prototypes and the presumed first versions of the original animatronics that eventually ended up broken and dilapidated.

The Withered animatronics debut in Five Nights at Freddy's 2 as the main antagonists and would later appear in the film series as their own entities.

The Withereds appear as larger, bulkier designs compared to their later counterparts. Their suits are made of a fabric with detached lower jaws and functional fingers and are shown in a dirty state.

They seem to have some shared design details from Endo-02, but with the added functionality of the Springlock mechanisms.
